Consider two closed loops $C _ { 1 }$ and $C _ { 2 }$ carrying current $I _ { 1 }$ and $I _ { 2 }$ respectively. Find the (17)   
expression of energy stored in the magnetic field. Also show that Newton's third law holds   
here.
